verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the SOC 2 Launchpad guide, which says users can 'action policies' after generating a blueprint. That is a first-party policy workflow, but the mention is thin and says nothing about how the workflow works. The GDPR document pack in the GitHub compliance-skills repo is a separate code-scan tool and is not credited here. Missing for 10: a lawyer-grade policy template library, an in-platform policy editor, version history, approval workflows, per-employee acceptance or attestation tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
